batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: st KD Karthik b Iqbal Abdulla

batting.name: JP Duminy
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b D Wiese

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b VR Aaron

batting.name: AD Mathews
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b VR Aaron

batting.name: KM Jadhav
batting.dismissal: c MA Starc b HV Patel

balls.text: Have Delhi been bowled out? Yes, Joseph has been caught miles short. AB comes into the action. This was another slower ball outside off, pushed to backward point, Gayle collects the ball but fails to effect a direct hit.  The back-up fielder fails to gather the ball, but AB de Villiers runs in from long-on and fires a direct hit at the bowlers'. Well, he is Neo, as Steyn put it!
good length slower ball on middle and off, waited and pushed in front of point
slower ball again, full and outside off. Joseph pushes away from the body and is beaten
slowy ball outside off, chipped over the bowler's head
very full at the base of off, squeezed to the leg side of the inside edge

Kedhar Jadav holes out, the last recognised batsman perishes. This was a length-ball outside off, Jadhav clears his front leg, goes for an almighty swipe and hits it into the hands of Starc at deep midwicket. Starc is everywhere
low full toss outside off, sliced to cover-point, finds the fielder
length ball outside off, he swings and does not connect
full ball comes in on middle, he backs away and blocks it to the off side. End of a fiery spell from Starc: 4-0-20-3
very full and on middle and leg, whipped with a flourish past midwicket for only one
low full toss outside off, poked to deep third man

Starc makes light work of Nadeem, third wicket for him. He fires in another pin-point yorker that swings away, Nadeem can't squeeze it out after backing away. Crashes into the off stump and Starc exults
bouncer outside off, he looks to upper cut and misses
back of a length and comes in with the angle on middle. He camps on the back foot and pushes it to mid-off
on a length and outside off, driven wide of point for one
Nadeem makes room outside leg Abdulla follows him Blocked back to the bowler
flatter length outside off, he aims to dink it away to short third. Gets it off the bottom of the bat
lobbed up outside off, driven to long-off
fuller and outside off, he pokes and misses
dropped shortish and outside off, cut off the back foot. Gayle dives at short third and stops the ball
fired outside off, Jadhav leaves it. Past the tram-line and wide called

Starc nails the yorker and rattles the off stump! This was just too good for Mishra. Yorker comes in with the angle and tails away late from round the stumps, Mishra brings his bat down late and fails to keep it out
back of a length and outside off, punched off the back foot to point
shortish and outside off, he rocks back and cuts it to the right of backward point. The big man - Gayle - dives awkwardly and saves the ball. Kohli applauds the effort
low full toss outside off, squeezed away to the right of third man, beats the fielder in the deep and gets a four
fuller and wide outside off, thrashed past the covers. Width on offer and Jadhav cashed in
low full toss angled in just outside off, he pushes at it and squirts it past the covers as the bat twists in his hand
on a length and outside off, hit uppishly over the covers
full and straight, whipped away to Starc at long leg

sixth pin down for DD. Fullish and angled in to beat the batsman's push and strike him on the back pad. This would have crashed into middle and leg. It was the slower one from Wiese and Coulter-Nile was hoodwinked. Kohli lets out a roar
back of a length from Wiese and width on offer as well, Coulter-Nile stands tall and crunches it past Virat Kohli at the covers. Beats mid-off as well
on a good length and comes in, he manages an inside edge onto the pad

good length and on middle, Jadhav takes a couple of paces forward and works it to short fine. There is a horrible mix-up in the middle as both batsmen converge at the strikers'. No harm done for DD, though. The fielder throws at the strikers' and misses. He should have attempted a direct hit at the non-strikers. There was no backing up and they get the single anyway via an overthrow
Abdulla drags his length back on middle, pushed to the right of the bowler
quicker one, he pushes at it and gets an inside edge to the left of Karthik
pushed through on off and spins away with some extra bounce, defended to point
straighter on off, forward and blocked to the covers
length on off, defended

The procession continues for Delhi. Dolly stumping for Karthik. Agarwal gives the charge, Abdullah lobs this up outside off. Agarwal is beaten in flight, can't loft it over the covers. Karthik does the rest
good length on middle, worked in front of mid-on
length and outside off, driven smoothly to long-off
slowy ball, Jadhav seeks to dab it away. Gets an inside-edge that dribbles to the left of the keeper. Karthik dives to his left and stops the ball
back of a length and on middle and leg, short-arm pulled through midwicket. Not middled
back of a length and slower on off, tucked behind square leg. Short fine leg gets forward and across as he hunts the ball down
fuller and shapes in outside off, Agarwal aims to drive, toe-ends it to mid-on
fuller and angled in on middle, tapped in front of mid-on for another single
slower, slipper bouncer on middle. Jadhav spots it, waits on it before half-pulling, half-paddling behind square on the leg side
good length ball comes in from outside off, coaxed with the wrists in front of mid-on for a scampered single
too full and outside off, Jadhav drills a drive to long-off and trots off to the other end
back of a length and outside off, he cuts again, this time finds the man at point
short and wide outside off, sits up with a 'hit me' label on it. Jadhav switches his balance onto the back foot and cuts it uppishly over backward point
angled in on off, driven straight to Kohli at extra-cover
tossed up and outside off, he eases it through cover-point
leg-stumpish ball, Jadhav sinks down to one knee and paddles it fine on the leg side. No protection there
on a length and outside off, Agarwal plays a wristy drive to sweeper cover
straighter one on middle, he hangs back and ticks it to the leg side again, this time behind square
pushed through on middle and leg, tucked away through square leg
good length on the fourth-stump line, he presses forward and pushes it to short cover. Aaron finishes 4-0-24-2
back of a length and outside off, he stands tall, gets on top of the bounce and punches it past the covers
banged in short and hurries on at 145s, he pulls it away to long leg
mighty full and swerves in on middle, near yorker. Jammed out to mid-on
on a length and zips through outside off with extra lift. Agarwal spars at it and is beaten
shortish and outside off, bounces over the attempted cut of Agarwal
round-armish on off, dropped in front of the covers for an urgent single
fuller and turning away close to off, patted to point with an open face
slid through on off, he looks to turn it to the leg side and gets a leading edge wide of the covers
lobbed up, spins away on a fourth-stump line, blocked to point
shortish and turns away outside off, punchily blocked back to Abdullah, who flicks the ball back onto the stumps. The non-striker, who had drifted out, backing up, turns back and makes his ground
flighted and outside off, driven to deep cover for one

another edge, did that carry to Karthik? They go to the TV umpire. Karthik was not all that confident and so was first slip. Full and speared wide outside off, Jadhav chases without any feet movement and gets an under edge. Dinesh Karthik moves to his right, the ball bounces before settling in the gloves
Aaron pounds the deck hard, shortish and seams away. Jadhav chases and is beaten. Wide
shortish and skiddy outside off, he wants to cut but has to settle with a chop to backward point
145.2ks bouncer outside off, he drops his wrists on it and lets it fly to Dinesh Karthik

Mathews has to walk back for a golden duck! He is on a hat-trick. This was also shortish, cramping Mathews for room. He looks to work it away after shuffling across and hopping up, instead he loops it in the air. AB runs across to his left from short midwicket and takes it at a square-leg region

Big strike, Yuvraj is gone now! Good delivery from Aaron, banged in short and seams away outside off with some extra bounce at 146ks. Yuvraj can't resist himself, he has a waft at it and feeds an edge to Karthik
full and wide outside off, Agarwal angles his bat and squeezes it to the left of deep third man
dug in shortish and outside off, stops on Yuvraj. He punches it between the covers and mid-off. Aaron runs back from mid-off, chases the ball. Slides and prevents the ball from reaching the boundary
very full and angling away outside off, Yuvraj opts for caution and shoulders arms
fuller and on middle and leg, shapes in. Clipped to mid-on
fuller and wider outside off, he flashes and misses

Duminy has nicked off! Back of a length away-going ball outside off. Duminy is crease-bound as he has a slash at it and bottom-edges it to the keeper. Karthik and Wiese go up for a caught-behind appeal. Affirmative, says the umpire
fullish and curling in, Agarwal accounts for the inward movement and dabs it gently in front of point
fuller and pushed outside off with some away-swing, well past the tram-line
fuller and angled in, another push to Starc at mid-on. This time the pair scamper across for a single
fuller and comes in on off, defensively pushed down to mid-on
back of a length and outside off, chopped by Duminy. DK dives across, full-length to his left, and collects the ball
dug in on a back of a length and outside off, Agarwal cuts it to the right of deep third man
fuller and outside off, Duminy comes forward and drives it past a diving cover. The man at mid-off has it covered
length ball angled in, defended back to the bowler
Aaron tests Agarwal with a bouncer. Disconcerting bounce, directed just above the ribs. Agarwal goes on the back foot and top-edges a pull over long leg. A bit too quick for Agarwal
fullish and angled in, Duminy squirts it to the leg side off an inside edge
shortish and down leg, Duminy tickles it past DK off a bottom edge. The keeper moves across to his right and dives in vain. Poor line from Aaron
stray ball - very full and swings down leg, wide called
shortish and climbs on middle, blocked to point off the back foot
fractionally back of a length and cuts back in close to off, pushed to extra-cover for an urgent single. AB swoops down on the ball but fails to effect a direct hit
back of a length and comes in a bit on off, Agarwal camps on the back foot as he defends it to short point with an angled bat
mighty full and outside off, not an accurate yorker. Duminy hangs back and squeezes it to the covers
drifting onto the pads of Duminy, who flicks his wrists and directs it to the left of Wiese ar mid-on. He gamely chases the ball, slides in the deep and restricts it to two
pitched further up and width on offer as well. Duminy leans forward and drives it between the covers and mid-off. Sweetly-timed
good length and swinging away outside off, Duminy does not bite. Left alone
late inswinger from Starc, very full again to strike the batsman low on the pad. Agarwal, like Iyer, was late to bring his bat down. But this was snaking down leg
pitched up and outside off, Agarwal drives uppishly and chips it in front of AB at the covers
Aaron ventures short and wide outside off, Duminy aims to pull. Mishits it to midwicket
good-ish length around off, Agawal waits on it, opens his bat face and squeezes a single behind point
back of a length and jagging in to rap Duminy on the front thigh as he does not connect with the flick. The ball rolls to the off side
dug in shortish and outside off, Agarwal rides the bounce and dabs it to deep third man
back of a length and outside off, swerving further, wide called
fuller and shapes in, Agarwal seeks to flick it away, manages a thick inside edge to the right of square leg
back of a length and rises on off, Agarwal taps it to point. Duminy sets off for a quick single, but is sent back. A direct hit could have put him in trouble
good length and on middle, blocked back to the bowler

Inswinging yorker. Boom. Iyer gone for a duck. This was hurled in on the blockhole, swings in. Iyer is late to bring his bat down in a bid to squirt it away. Trapped on the front pad in front of the leg stump. It would have grazed leg. The forefinger goes up
veering down leg, Iyer can't glance it away. DK dives across to his left and collects the ball
pitched wide outside off, Agarwal leans forward and drives it to deep third man
much fuller and angled across off, Agarwal chases it with a tame drive and is beaten again
beaten soundly is Agarwal. On a good length and swinging in close to off, Agarwal has a nibble at it and the ball zips past the outside edge
on length and angling away outside off, Agarwal lets it be
Kohli seals it with a four, RCB win by 10 wickets! Length outside off, Kohli shovel-drives it between the bowler and Gayle
full and wide outside off, Kohli simply throws his bat at it after backing away. The thick outside edge runs away past slip to the third-man boundary
dug in shortish and on middle, Gayle lifts it over the bowler's head. Not middled. Duminy moves across to his left from mid-on but the ball evades his reach
back of a length and outside off, Kohli camps on the back foot and  and whisks it to short-midwicket off an inside edge
dug in short and on middle and leg, Gayle is cramped for room. Mishit pull over backward square leg. Tahir runs across to his right from deep midwicket and cuts it off
bumper from Mathews. Gayle wound up for a big hit before letting it fly to the keeper
shortish and outside off, Gayle looks to pull and drags it to mid-on off the inner part of the bat
back of a length and on off, punched down to long-on
shortish and outside off, he rocks back and pulls it in the air. Duminy gets both his hands onto the ball at short midwicket, but it bursts through. Difficult chance, for the ball was travelling fast
looks like a googly, shortish length. Kohli seeks to punch and gets an inside edge to short midwicket
half-tracker on middle, Kohli rocks back and pulls it to the deep midwicket boundary. Iyer dives across his right in the deep but can only parry it away to the boundary
flatter and on middle, Gayle clears his front leg and shovel-whips it to long-on, on the bounce
slid through on middle, Kohli goes on the back foot and punches it down to long-on
pushed through on the pads, swept away behind square towards long leg
Boom! Launched into the second tier. Tossed up and full on middle, Gayle clears his front leg and annihilates a six over the bowler's head
sliding down leg, wide
straighter and quicker, driven down to long-off
Tahir goes up for a big lbw appeal. The umpire says no. This was the googly from Tahir, Gayle does not connect with the attempted sweep and takes it on the pad. It may have pitched outside leg
Gayle looks to flick it away, nearly lobbed it back to the bowler off a leading edge
fifty for Gayle and he gets there in style. This was fuller and outside off, Gayle smashes a slog-sweep and sends it over midwicket
tossed up, slapped back at the bowler, who gets his right hand to it and deflects it onto the umpire's thigh, who was taking evasive action
quicker legbreak outside off, he rocks back and cracks a cut behind point and beats short third man too, the ball fizzes away
fullish and on off, wristy drive down to long-on. 11 off Mishra's first over
nudged off the pads behind square leg
shortish from Mishra again, shovelled down to long-on with plenty of bottom hand power
flattish and on middle and leg, whipped away as Kohli hangs back, bisecting the gap between long-on and deep midwicket
Kohli special. Tossed up outside off, he runs down the track, makes some room and drives it imperiously past the covers
flighted and on off, blocked back to the bowler
Kohli nips down the track, gets a full one on middle and leg, flicked away wide of midwicket
flat dart on the leg stump, whipped to long-on. Gayle settles with one, he doesn't like twos. He loves fours and sixes
much slower through the air, blocked to the off side
quicker outside off, pitched up. Gayle hammers it to the left of mid-off, sped away
down the track and knocked to long-on for one
flighted on off, tapped to the leg side
pitched up and outside off, width on offer now. Gayle slices it over extra-cover for a flat six. Looks like he is in the mood
Coulter-Nile bowls a bouncer at 142ks, cramps Gayle for room. He gets into a tangle, takes his eyes off the ball and mis-controls a pull over short fine
dug in shortish and on middle and off, Gayle steps away, ventures deep in the crease and punches to mid-off. It was the slower one and Gayle could not manufacture his own pace
shortish and rises on middle, Gayle pats it to point again
good length on leg, Gayle stands on leg and dabs it to point
back of a length and angled in on middle, tucked away to the left of deep midwicket
fractionally back of a length and on middle and leg, whipped away to deep midwicket off the back foot
half-tracker on off, Gayle rocks back and pulls it to long-on
skids off the deck on off, Kohli goes on the back foot as he punches it wide of mid-on
quicker on middle and leg, whipped to deep midwicket
fuller and on middle and leg, another wrong'un, Gayle is down on one knee as he looks to slog sweep, off the inner part of the bat towards the backward square leg boundary
googly from Tahir, Gayle swipes and can't connect. Takes it on the pad
back of a length, top-of-off line, blocked to point
Coulter-Nile slips it very full and on middle and leg, Gayle manages an inside-edge, that rebounds towards short third man off the pad
back of a length and outside off, offcutter, Gayle hangs back and punches it past the covers. Beats mid-off as well. JP Duminy chases the ball in vain
good length on the leg stump, no room for Gayle. He blocks and it rolls back to the bowler
back of a length with some away movement outside off, Kohli reads it as he steers it to deep third man
banged in short and rises outside off, Kohli rises with it and defends it onto the pitch
this was far too full on the stumps, Gayle drills it to the left of the bowler. It just sped away to the long-on boundary
back of a length and outside off, this keeps low and does not bounce at all. Gayle swings but the ball slides under his bat
dragged short and outside off, Gayle sizes it up, pulls it stylishly over midwicket with one feet lifted in the air
on a length and outside off, right in Gayle's zone. He launches it over long-off for a six
fullish and angling away, Gayle swishes his bat out of the way again
back of a length and shaping away outside off with the angle, Gayle lets it be
fuller and angling away, Gayle has a swipe at it and drags it to fine leg off an inside edge
fuller and outside off, Gayle swats it to midwicket off the inside part of the bat. Iyer goes low but fumbles, allowing Gayle to open his account
bouncer down leg, Gayle semi-ducks and leaves it
fuller and angling away outside off, Gayle swishes his bat out of the way
dug in short and angling away outside off, Gayle drags his bat inside the line and lets it pass
fuller length ball tailing in on middle, Gayle stays back and blocks it to the covers
back of a length and outside off, Gayle is glued to the crease as he flashes and gets beaten
